name: Ridgway
label: Ridgway
title: Ridgway's Color Standards and Color Nomenclature
description: 1117 named colours published in 1912 by the American ornithologist Robert Ridgway, arranged on 53 plates from pure hues to greyed and darkened tones. Sanzo Wada took his colour names from this book, so it is the wider vocabulary behind the Wada family. Use it when a combination needs a shade Wada does not have.
source: Robert Ridgway, Color Standards and Color Nomenclature, Washington DC, 1912
data: color-standards-and-color-nomenclature 1.1.0 by Davo Galavotti, MIT licence; the book is in the public domain in the USA
note: Values were sampled from scans of the printed plates, which have aged.
